tools.name: check_sign_compatibility
tools.description: Returns how two zodiac signs match: a verdict label, the wheel aspect and its angle, the elements and modalities, and one line each for love, friendship and work. Accepts two signs, or two birth dates whose Sun signs are read by month and day; a birthday near a sign change returns the possible pairs

tools.name: get_sign_profile
tools.description: Returns a zodiac sign's dates, element, modality, ruler and polarity, its traits, how it behaves in love, friendship and work, and its compatibility verdict with all twelve signs, with the strongest matches named.

tools.name: find_sun_sign
tools.description: Returns the tropical Sun sign for a birth date. On a day the Sun changes sign it returns both possible signs, or the exact sign when a place and an optional birth time are given.

tools.name: find_moon_sign
tools.description: Returns the Moon's tropical zodiac sign for a birth date, with its degree when a birth time is given. Without a time it returns every sign the Moon visited that local date and when it changed sign.

tools.name: find_rising_sign
tools.description: Returns the rising sign (Ascendant) with its degree, and the Descendant, Midheaven and Imum Coeli signs, for a birth date, time and place. Notes when the Ascendant lies within 1.5 degrees of a sign boundary.

tools.name: find_venus_sign
tools.description: Returns the sign Venus was in on a birth date, with its degree and whether it was retrograde. A date on which Venus changed sign returns both signs unless a birth time is given.

tools.name: get_birth_chart
tools.description: Returns a tropical birth chart with whole-sign houses: the Sun, Moon and rising signs, each planet's sign, degree and house, the Ascendant and Midheaven, and up to ten of the tightest major aspects. Without a birth time the planets keep every sign possible that day and the houses and angles are omit

tools.name: get_synastry
tools.description: Returns up to ten of the tightest major aspects between two people's birth charts, each with a short meaning, and a reading for one relationship setting built from the planets that setting weighs. Each person is given by birth date, optional birth time and a place.

tools.name: get_daily_horoscope
tools.description: Returns a sign's reading for a UTC date, built from that day's real planet positions: the day's reading with the transits it uses, a one-line preview of the next day, and a line for each of the following seven days.
